name: Influence Direction
summary: L5 defines the directional axis of unseen influence. It is the second structural component of the gradient node and determines the orientation of gradientIntensity within the S3 Spine.

description.canonical: L5 establishes the directional orientation of unseen influence. It refines the origin defined by L4 and determines the slope, heading, and directional bias of gradientIntensity.
description.cosmology: In the cosmology chain, L5 represents the emergence of directional bias from proto-origin states. It is the second stage of gradient formation within force-regime mechanics.
description.spine: Within the S3 Spine, L5 is the directional dimension of the gradient node, shaping the influence vector that precedes field formation.
description.mcp: In MCP operations, L5 is used to orient gradient-state mechanics, providing the directional coordinate for influence modeling.

ai.purpose: Defines the directional axis of unseen influence for AI reasoning and MCP gradient orientation.
